resources.string: This TS7Play build has no valid CarPlay authentication. Use an authenticated build with the same application ID, or select an available authentication provider in Connection settings.
Connection, display, audio, startup and diagnostics are available in the built-in DiPlay settings.
Open DiPlay to use this display configuration.
A receiver is already running. Open DiPlay or disconnect it before starting another connection.
This app is no longer available. Choose another app.
Connect the head unit and iPhone to the same Wi-Fi network. Pair the iPhone in Android Bluetooth settings, then select it below. Open and WPA2 networks are supported.
Wi-Fi password (empty for an open network)
No paired phones. Open Android Bluetooth settings and pair the iPhone first.
Microphone and Bluetooth permissions are required for a complete CarPlay session. Local network access is also required on Android 17 and later.
Fixed 960 × 540 main display, 30 fps, H.264. The picture keeps its 16:9 ratio; touch uses the same area. The local toolbar stays available.
Enable microphone for calls and Siri
Audio changes apply to the next connection. Verify music, navigation prompts, calls, Siri and the original radio on this head unit.
Retry after screen sleep and wake
Screen wake is a generic signal. ACC and reverse-camera behavior must be verified on this TS7 firmware. Returning Home alone never resets a failed attempt or a manual disconnect.
The report could not be saved. Choose a writable document location.
Enter a non-empty SSID of up to 32 UTF-8 bytes and an empty or 8–63 character WPA2 password.
Select a paired iPhone before connecting.
Runtime authentication is missing or invalid. Build a standalone test APK with the supplied accessory identity.

Bluetooth is off. Enable it in system settings.

The Wi-Fi network changed or disconnected.
Check the saved network, Bluetooth pairing and authentication configuration.
The CarPlay connection ended. Check the iPhone and network.
Wi-Fi recovery is required. Reconnect the head unit to the existing network in system settings, then tap Connect.
Android Bluetooth could not reach the paired iPhone. Check Bluetooth pairing in system settings.
The previous connection has not stopped safely. Close and restart the app before retrying.
Android could not start the session. Check app permissions and try again while the launcher is visible.
Automatic attempts have stopped. Tap Connect to try again.

The result is checked after returning. Firmware Home-button routing needs a separate test.

Local ADB authorization or the hotspot-control grant was not completed.
